measurement: per-case routing evidence (expect_agent + expect_intent) via leaf-01 RoutingObservation, single dispatch per fresh session

verdict_rule.case_pass: all routing checks pass for the case (expect_agent AND expect_intent, from leaf-01 RoutingObservation, evidence_status=available)
verdict_rule.policy_score: routed_correct / 48 (every case gets a live dispatch verdict; abstention is not possible live, so routed == 48 or the case is an error row and excluded with an explicit count)

bands.meaning: live chain landing beats the modeled 0.868-era bar with real answers
measurement valid; policy needs lane work (expected: quickplan/review/code boundary variance on the 8B)
live chain landing is not acceptance-grade

amendment.what: replaced flat pass bar >= 0.80 with graded PASS/MARGINAL/FAIL bands
amendment.why: 0.80 anchored to the manufactured 0.868-era constant; pre-phase-2 evidence (phase-1 routed 7/9=0.778, live acceptance 5/8=0.625, 20/48 quickplan mix) makes a flat bar a near-certain FAIL regardless of policy merit; bands set BEFORE any phase-2 observation per the pre-registration rule
amendment.error_rows: cases with evidence_status != available are counted separately and excluded from the denominator; if >10% of cases are error rows the run itself is INVALID

chain_constant: NOT used — this phase measures actual chain landing, replacing the 0.868 reference
model: local 8B LFM2.5-8B-A1B-Q4_K_M on llama.cpp (scratch rig, same recipe as the 2026-09-18 acceptance passes)

amendments.what: added neutral exit_zero(true) checker to every case
amendments.why: suite loader requires >=1 checker per task; phase 2 is routing-only so a neutral checker preserves the measurement (routing checks evaluated separately)
